raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "objectlist" %}
{% set version = "1.0.2" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/objectlist-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 8b3b54c28dc5deafec5e5cac4365aa0141adedd0d63b07ca6f69d5aab3547131

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  number: 1

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - setuptools >=61.0.0
    - wheel
    - pip
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - numpy >=1.22
    - joblib
    - tqdm

test:
  imports:
    - objectlist
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/Chirlmin-Joo-lab/objectlist
  summary: Use methods and method chaining on lists of objects.
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ivoseverins
